params.caption: O'zbekchada "e'tibor bermoq" deymiz, shuning uchun ko'pchilik inglizchada ham do yoki make ishlatib yuboradi. Aslida inglizlar e'tiborni "to'laydi": pay attention to. Undan keyin to keladi, on yoki at emas. Please pay attention to the instructions, ko'rsatmalarga e'tibor bering. Sorry, I wasn't paying attention, kechirasiz, chalg'ib qolibman. Pay attention to how native speakers stress words, ular so'zlarga urg'uni qanday berishiga e'tibor bering. Yana bir narsa: bu ma'noda attention sanalmaydi, demak "attentions" demaymiz. Kuchaytirmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'rtasiga sifat qo'shing: pay close attention, pay special attention.
